name: Maacah (daughter of Absalom)
title: Rehoboam's favorite wife
summary: Maacah, granddaughter of Absalom, was King Rehoboam's most beloved wife and mother of King Abijah of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Rehoboam's favorite wife
keyEvents.description: Rehoboam loved Maacah, the daughter of Absalom, more than all his other wives, and appointed her son Abijah as heir to the throne.
